_comment: merge: { "<duplicatePlayerId>": <canonicalPlayerId> } joins two league player ids into one profile. names: { "<playerId>": { "first": "...", "last": "..." } } renames a player everywhere on the site (profiles, game reports, stats, leader lists), e.g. 115795 Aleksei Moskalenko -> "Moskalenko Jr." to tell him apart from Andrei Moskalenko. Player ids are in the profile URL (/de/players/<id>-name/).
